name: Simple Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, Alyissia calls young night elf warriors to defend their people. Conservator Ilthalaine carries her summons as the Kaldorei face changes across Teldrassil and beyond.

sections.title: A Call to Arms in Shadowglen
sections.body: After you prove your basic survival skills against Shadowglen's restless wildlife, Conservator Ilthalaine gives you an inscribed sigil. The token formally marks your move into combat training. It carries a request from Alyissia, the warrior trainer at Aldrassil, asking you to dedicate your strength to defending your people.

sections.title: A Tumultuous New Era
sections.body: Alyissia sets your training against a time of rapid change and danger. In only a few years, the night elves have raised the World Tree Teldrassil, seen a taint spread through forest beasts near and far, and reconnected with ancient lands once thought lost, including Feralas. The Kaldorei need capable defenders against these perils.

sections.title: Opening the Boughs
sections.body: Alyissia prepares young Kaldorei for more than combat. She urges you not to judge outsiders who arrive on Teldrassil by their race. Some travelers may not act from pure generosity, but allies are vital to the Kaldorei's defense. As you take up the work of protecting your people, she asks you to offer them reasonable trust.

faq.answer: The inscribed sigil is sent by Alyissia, the warrior trainer in Shadowglen, and delivered to novice night elf warriors as they begin formal combat instruction.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Alyissia?
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine delivers the sigil and directs you to Alyissia after you complete your first work maintaining the balance in Shadowglen.
Alyissia trains aspiring night elf warriors near the great trunk of Aldrassil, within Shadowglen's safe haven.

faq.q: Why does Alyissia say warriors are needed right now?
aliases: why do night elves need warriors
faq.answer: The night elves have raised Teldrassil, corruption has spread through local wildlife, and the Kaldorei have rediscovered ancient lands such as Feralas. Skilled fighters are needed to shield their people from these threats.

faq.q: What does Alyissia say about other races visiting Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Alyissia advises you not to judge visitors to Teldrassil by their race. Though not every traveler acts from pure generosity, she urges you to offer some trust so they may help defend the tree.

faq.q: What is the significance of mentioning Feralas?
faq.answer: Feralas is an ancient night elf land long cut off or believed lost after the Great Sundering. Its rediscovery shows how the Kaldorei are reconnecting with the wider world after millennia of isolation.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei warrior, you begin your training with Alyissia as your first mentor in arms.
The sigil points to the rapid changes around the Kaldorei, from the raising of Teldrassil to opening their secluded home to foreign allies.
Alyissia's counsel reflects the night elves' early efforts to welcome other Alliance races to their boughs after centuries of isolation.
